dialogues.speaker: Ebeid
dialogues.text: Gah, I'm so bored... If the older boys won't let us skim stones, why don't we—

dialogues.speaker: Hilmi
dialogues.text: Hey, hey, you're not gonna suggest that again, are you...

dialogues.speaker: Ebeid
dialogues.text: Yeah, that's exactly what I mean—

dialogues.speaker: Ebeid
dialogues.text: Step one is closing the roads! Come on, let's go block the suspension bridge...

dialogues.speaker: Hilmi
dialogues.text: Let's do something else... We're gonna get caught by Habachi long before we get to the suspension bridge...

dialogues.speaker: Ebeid
dialogues.text: But... what are we supposed to do, then? Do you have anything in mind that we can do for fun?

dialogues.speaker: Hilmi
dialogues.text: Hmm... How about a race to the... what color was it again? I always forget.

dialogues.speaker: Hilmi
dialogues.text: Whatever the case, let's climb up that elevator. Whoever climbs the highest wins!

dialogues.speaker: Ebeid
dialogues.text: But we would just be trading a scolding from Habachi for one from Kazim, right?
